Check out KBBI — the Indonesian dictionary app!
KBBI is an unofficial Indonesian dictionary app developed by Ar Razy Fathan Rabbani. This policy explains what information the app handles, why it is handled, and the choices available to you.

When you search for a word, proverb, or translation, your query is sent to the dictionary service configured for the app. Word searches also include a random visitor identifier stored on your device so the service can distinguish visits. The app stores search history, bookmarks, dictionary and proverb cache, language selection, notification preferences, and update-check preferences on your device. The app does not require an account and does not intentionally collect your name, email address, contacts, precise location, or payment information.

Information is used to provide dictionary searches, translations, proverb results, offline access, bookmarks, search history, reminders, and app-update checks. The app contains no advertising or analytics SDK. The dictionary service may process technical network information, such as your IP address, according to its own infrastructure and policies.

Bookmarks, history, cached content, preferences, and the visitor identifier remain in local Android storage until you delete them, clear app data, uninstall the app, or the operating system removes them. Android device backup may include app data depending on your device and backup settings. The app does not control retention on the remote dictionary service.

Microphone access is requested only when you use voice search. Speech recognition is provided by Android or the recognition service selected on your device and may process audio outside the app. Notification access is requested only when you enable daily reminders. You can deny or later revoke either permission in Android settings.

The app communicates with its configured dictionary API, checks GitHub for release updates, and may open GitHub links when you report a bug or share the project. Those services receive the network information necessary to fulfill your request and are governed by their own terms and privacy policies.

You can clear search history from Settings, remove bookmarks individually, disable reminders, deny microphone or notification permissions, clear app data, or uninstall the app. To ask a privacy question, use the public GitHub issue tracker and do not include sensitive personal information.

KBBI is a general-purpose dictionary app. It does not knowingly request personal information from children or require an account. If you believe a child has provided personal information through a service used by the app, please contact us through the repository issue tracker.
This policy may be updated when the app’s data practices or legal requirements change. The effective date at the top of this page indicates the latest version included in the app.
Privacy questions can be submitted at https://github.com/arrazyfathan/kbbi/issues. Please avoid posting passwords, identifiers, documents, or other sensitive information in a public issue.
By installing or using KBBI, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, do not use the app. You must comply with applicable laws when using the app.

KBBI provides dictionary, translation, proverb, bookmarking, history, voice-search, reminder, and related features. It is an unofficial project and is not operated by or affiliated with the Indonesian government or the official KBBI publisher.

Dictionary and proverb content may come from bundled data or remote services and may be incomplete, delayed, or inaccurate. Use the app for reference and learning, not as a substitute for professional, legal, medical, or official advice. We may change, remove, or limit content and features at any time.

Do not misuse the app, overload or probe its services, bypass technical limits, interfere with another user’s access, or use the app to violate law or third-party rights. You are responsible for queries and other actions made from your device.

Searches, translations, speech recognition, release checks, and external links may depend on third-party services. Their availability, content, terms, and privacy practices are outside the app’s control. Your use of those services may be subject to their separate terms.

The KBBI app source code is distributed under the license provided in the project repository. Third-party libraries, dictionary data, trademarks, and external content remain subject to their respective owners and licenses. These Terms do not transfer ownership to you.

The app is provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. To the extent permitted by law, the publisher disclaims warranties and is not responsible for indirect loss, data loss, service interruption, or reliance on dictionary content. Nothing in these Terms limits rights that cannot legally be limited.

We may update these Terms, change the app, or discontinue features. Continued use after an updated version is included in the app means you accept the updated Terms. You may stop using the app and uninstall it at any time.
Questions about these Terms can be submitted at https://github.com/arrazyfathan/kbbi/issues. Do not post confidential or sensitive information in a public issue.
